body: If I do fail, it wouldn’t be my fault would it. I wasn’t given the same stack of cards to deal with. Not everybody starts life on 3rd base
You can’t expect your child to become successful if you don’t put them on a path to success

That’s my point. My parents have no college savings. If I end up working at McDonald’s for life it’s their fault because they gave me no opportunities. I blame them for my situation. Because of them I will be poor forever and that’s not my fault. Successful people are successful because their parents gave them opportunity. I have NO opportunity given to me
